lct.intro.text: The <color=#748421>Lizard Cult</color> wishes to spread our gospel throughout the woodland. You must seek <color=#748421>outcasts</color> and <color=#748421>acolytes</color> to crusade for your cause and defend your sanctum. But your fight is not with tooth and claw alone. Tending to your <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> reveals a path to victory through mysterious rituals.

lct.place.warriors.text: You start the game with 4 humble <color=#748421>warriors</color> and a <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color> building in the corner clearing opposite the Marquise de Cat Keep.

lct.adjacent.warriors.text: In addition, you place a warrior in each clearing adjacent to your starting <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color>.

lct.explain.reveal.text: During Daylight, you perform <color=#748421>ritual</color> actions by revealing cards from your hand.

lct.recruit.intro.text: Using the <color=#748421>Recruit</color> ritual you may reveal a card from your hand to recruit a warrior in a clearing matching its suit.

lct.reveal.icon.text: The cards you reveal are moved to the <sprite name="eyeicon"> area and can't be used for rituals again until your next turn.

lct.first.build.text: Let's try another <color=#748421>ritual</color> using a different card in our hand. Use the <color=#748421>Build</color> ritual to reveal a <sprite name="mouseicon"> card and place a <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color> in a matching clearing you rule.

lct.pilgrims.text: You automatically rule any clearing where you have a <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color>. Even non-believers are in awe of their divine properties.

lct.garden.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> can be used to score points with the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual. Tap your avatar to learn more about <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color>.

lct.garden.gamepad.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> can be used to score points with the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual. Press <sprite name="Switch_LeftBumper"> to learn more about <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color>.

lct.garden.track.text: The more <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> you have on the map of a suit, the more points you score when using the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual.

lct.garden.draw.text: You uncover a <sprite name="DrawCard"> when you have two <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> of the same suit on the map. Doing so increases the cards you draw during Evening.

lct.score.text: Use the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual to discard a <sprite name="mouseicon"> card and gain <style="vpnum">2</style>. This is a unique and powerful ritual that requires you discard the card you used rather than reveal it.

lct.score.2.text: You may perform the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual only once per suit each turn.

lct.return.text: The cards you revealed for rituals are now returned to your hand.

lct.strategy.text: Carefully managing the suits in your hand is key to the cult's success.

lct.marquise.dialog.attack.text: Time to kick these zealots back to the stone age! En garde!

lct.revenge.text: These whiskered heathens have dealt a blow to our warriors. Thankfully, our <color=#748421>Revenge</color> ability allows us to transform our fallen defending <color=#748421>warriors</color> into <color=#748421>acolytes</color>.

lct.pick.outcast.text: The <color=#748421>Outcast</color> determines the clearing suits you can interact with using your <color=#748421>acolytes</color>. Choosing <sprite name="mouseicon"> will allow us to wage war against enemies in <sprite name="mouseicon"> clearings this turn.

lct.pick.outcast.2.text: In a typical game you will choose the initial <color=#748421>Outcast</color> suit during setup, but the cult makes exceptions for true believers like you.

lct.intro.conspiracy.text: Now that we have an <color=#748421>Outcast</color> and enough <color=#748421>acolytes</color>, we can perform <color=#748421>conspiracies</color> during Birdsong. <color=#748421>Conspiracies</color> are a set of conflict oriented actions that use <color=#748421>acolytes</color> instead of cards in hand.

lct.crusade.text: Spend two <color=#748421>acolytes</color> to use the <color=#748421>Crusade</color> Conspiracy. This will allow you to move 2 warriors from a clearing matching the suit of the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> to battle in an adjacent clearing.

lct.t2.marquise.text: These wackos again? A fistful of steel should show them who's boss!

lct.flavor.battle.text: May this burning pyre of sawdust please the gods.

lct.hatred.birds.text: Because of your <color=#748421>Hatred of Birds</color>, your <sprite name="birdicon"> cards can't be used as any suit for performing rituals. Instead they are used for a unique ritual called <color=#748421>Sacrifice</color>.

lct.intro.sacrifice.text: Reveal <sprite name="birdicon"> cards for the <color=#748421>Sacrifice</color> ritual to transform warriors in your supply into more <color=#748421>Acolytes</color> that can be used for <color=#748421>Conspiracies</color>.

lct.t2.ritual.text: Our rituals offer flexibility in where to recruit and build on the map. Let's <color=#748421>Recruit</color> to a new area of the map now.

lct.t2.craft.text: Reveal a <sprite name="rabbiticon"> to add a <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color> to the clearing where you destroyed your enemy's sawmill.

lct.t2.craft.2.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> matching the suit of the outcast contribute towards crafting during evening. Use their crafting power to score Root Tea.

lct.lost.souls.text: Used and discarded cards from all players go to the <color=#748421>Lost Souls</color> pile rather than the discard pile. The most common suit of these <color=#748421>Lost Souls</color> will determine the suit of the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> at the start of your turn.

lct.enemy.lost.souls.text: Enemy cards go to the <color=#748421>Lost Souls</color> pile as well. Watch out, even a careful plot to control the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> suit can be disrupted by clever opponents.

lct.t3.outcast.text: At the start of your turn, the most common suit in the <color=#748421>Lost Souls</color> pile (ignoring <sprite name="birdicon">) determines the new <color=#748421>Outcast</color>. Then the <color=#748421>lost souls</color> pile is sent to the discard pile.

lct.t3.outcast.2.text: Since <sprite name="rabbiticon"> was the most common suit, it becomes the new Outcast.

lct.t3.crusade.battle.text: There is more than one way to <color=#748421>Crusade</color>. Rather than move from an <color=#748421>Outcast</color> clearing and battle in a neighboring clearing you can also battle in the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> clearing itself. Do so now to protect your <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color>.

lct.t3.crusade.battle.2.text: Success. However, you lost a warrior in the battle. Remember, only <color=#748421>warriors</color> lost in battles where you were the DEFENDER seek revenge by becoming <color=#748421>acolytes</color>.

lct.t3.sacrifice.text: Use the <color=#748421>Sacrifice</color> action three times to gain more <color=#748421>acolytes</color>.

lct.t3.recruit.text: Use the <color=#748421>Recruit</color> action to place another <color=#748421>warrior</color> near your <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color>.

lct.t3.recruit.2.text: Finally let's <color=#748421>Recruit</color> again to establish rule in the <sprite name="rabbiticon"> clearing near your <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color>.

lct.t3.discard.text: You have too many cards in hand. Discarding two bunny cards will help to ensure the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> will become the <color=#748421>Hated Outcast</color>.

lct.t3.discard.2.text: Being hated sounds bad you say? No no... the righteous are often misunderstood. Patience friend, you will see.

lct.t4.hated.outcast.text: As foretold, the most common suit in the Lost Souls pile is the same as the suit of the current <color=#748421>Outcast</color>. When this happens, the <color=#748421>Outcast</color> becomes the <color=#748421>Hated Outcast</color>, reducing the cost of your <color=#748421>conspiracies</color> by 1!

lct.t4.convert.text: The <color=#748421>Lizard Cult</color> welcomes new blood with open arms. Use the <color=#748421>Convert</color> conspiracy to replace an enemy warrior in an <color=#748421>Outcast</color> clearing with one of our own.

lct.t4.sanctify.text: We must purify not only souls, but false monuments as well. Use <color=#748421>Sanctify</color>, to replace an enemy building with a <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color>.

lct.t4.off.rails.text: Your knowledge of our sacred text is nearly complete. Score <style="vpnumddteen">12</style> to prove your undying allegiance to the <color=#748421>Lizard Cult</color>.

lct.ftt.garden.removed.text: When a <color=#748421>garden</color> is removed, it returns to your garden track, often reducing the victory points scored by rituals. In addition, you lose a random card in hand. Protect <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Garden</color> at all costs.

tutorial.description.tutorialR01.text: Learn to play the Lizard Cult

lct.intro.text: <color=#748421>蜥蜴神教</color>希望在丛林中传播福音。你必须寻找<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>和<color=#748421>仆从</color>来发动圣战，保护你的圣坛，传播你的思想。但你的战斗并不仅仅依靠牙尖爪利。通过<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>的神秘仪式你也可以获得胜利。

lct.place.warriors.text: 你在开始游戏时拥有 4 个<color=#748421>士兵</color>和一个<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>。你要选择猫咪贵族对角的那个领地开始。

lct.adjacent.warriors.text: 另外，你要在和你的初始<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>相邻的领地上都放置 1 个士兵。

lct.explain.reveal.text: 白天阶段，你可以进行<color=#748421>仪式</color>行动，只需要展示你的手牌即可。

lct.recruit.intro.text: 通过<color=#748421>招募</color>仪式，你可以展示一张手牌来在对应类型的领地上招募 1 个士兵。

lct.reveal.icon.text: 你展示的卡牌移动到<sprite name="eyeicon">区域，而且直到下个回合，不能再被用于仪式。

lct.first.build.text: 现在让我们试试用另一张手牌来发动另一个<color=#748421>仪式</color>。<color=#748421>建造</color>行动可以展示一张<sprite name="mouseicon">类型的牌，并在一个你控制的对应类型的领地上放置一个<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>。

lct.pilgrims.text: 你自动控制所有拥有<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>的领地。那些非信徒也会惊叹于圣坛的壮丽。

lct.garden.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>可以让你通过<color=#748421>得分</color>仪式获得分数。点击你的头像查看更多关于<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>的信息。

lct.garden.gamepad.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color> can be used to score points with the <color=#748421>Score</color> ritual. Press <sprite name="Switch_LeftBumper"> to learn more about <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>Gardens</color>.

lct.garden.track.text: 你拥有的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>越多，你在进行<color=#748421>得分</color>仪式时得到的分数越多。

lct.garden.draw.text: 你每有 2 个相同类型的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>便获得 1 个<sprite name="DrawCard">，这可以让你在夜晚抽取额外的卡牌。

lct.score.text: 发动<color=#748421>得分</color>仪式，弃掉 1 张<sprite name="mouseicon">牌，获得<style="vpnum">2</style>点分数。这是一个独特而强大的仪式，需要通过弃牌来发动，而不是展示卡牌。

lct.score.2.text: 你每个回合，每个类型只可以进行一次<color=#748421>得分</color>仪式。

lct.return.text: 现在你之前展示过的卡牌将会返回你的手牌。

lct.strategy.text: 神教的成功在于妥善的处理遭弃者的类型。

lct.marquise.dialog.attack.text: 是时候把那些非信徒打回石器时代了！前进！

lct.revenge.text: 这些非信徒让我们损失了一些士兵。幸好我们拥有<color=#748421>复仇</color>能力，让我们可以将作为防守方损失的<color=#748421>士兵</color>转化为<color=#748421>仆从</color>。

lct.pick.outcast.text: <color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型决定了你的<color=#748421>仆从</color>可以行动的领地类型。选择<sprite name="mouseicon">类型将会让我们可以在这个回合针对<sprite name="mouseicon">类型的领地发起战斗。

lct.pick.outcast.2.text: 在通常的游戏中，你只能在设置阶段选择第一个回合的<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型。但蜥蜴神教可以为像你这样的虔诚者开个特例。

lct.intro.conspiracy.text: 现在我们拥有<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>领地，并且还有足够的<color=#748421>仆从</color>，我们可以在清晨阶段执行<color=#748421>阴谋</color>。<color=#748421>阴谋</color>是一些通过使用<color=#748421>仆从</color>而非卡牌来进行的行动。

lct.crusade.text: 花费 2 个<color=#748421>仆从</color>来发动<color=#748421>圣战</color>阴谋。这可以让你从<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型的领地移动 2 个士兵，并对相邻领地发动战斗。

lct.t2.marquise.text: 又是这些家伙？现在是时候让他们知道我们的厉害了！

lct.flavor.battle.text: 愿熊熊烈火愉悦我们的圣灵！

lct.hatred.birds.text: 因为你的<color=#748421>憎恶飞鹰</color>能力，你的<sprite name="birdicon">飞鹰类型卡牌不能在仪式中当作百搭牌使用。他们只能用于一个特殊的仪式：<color=#748421>献祭</color>。

lct.intro.sacrifice.text: 展示<sprite name="birdicon">卡牌，进行<color=#748421>牺牲</color>仪式，来将你的供给堆中的士兵转化为<color=#748421>仆从</color>，而仆从可以用于发动<color=#748421>阴谋</color>。

lct.t2.ritual.text: 我们的仪式在招募和建造上提供了很大的灵活性。现在让我们在一个新的领地进行<color=#748421>招募</color>吧。

lct.t2.craft.text: 展示一张<sprite name="rabbiticon">牌，在你刚刚摧毁了敌人的锯木厂的领地建造<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color> 。

lct.t2.craft.2.text: <sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>和遭弃者类型对应了夜晚锻造时的卡牌类型。使用锻造来获得草根茶吧。

lct.lost.souls.text: 所有玩家使用过的和弃掉的卡牌都会进入<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>牌堆，而不是弃牌堆。这些<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>牌中数量最多的类型将会成为你的回合中的<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型。

lct.enemy.lost.souls.text: 敌人的卡牌也会进入<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>牌堆。要注意聪明的对手可能会打乱你关于<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型的计划。

lct.t3.outcast.text: 在你的回合开始时，<color=#748421>遭弃者牌堆</color>中除了飞鹰<sprite name="birdicon">类型之外的数量最多的类型将会成为新的<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>。然后<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>牌堆将会全部进入弃牌堆。

lct.t3.outcast.2.text: <sprite name="rabbiticon">是数量最多，所以他是新的遭弃者类型。

lct.t3.crusade.battle.text: 有很多手段来发动<color=#748421>圣战</color>。你可以从一个<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>领地出发，在相邻的领地发起战斗。也可以在<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>领地本身发动战斗。现在就这样做吧，保护你的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>。

lct.t3.crusade.battle.2.text: 成功了！但是你在战斗中损失了一个士兵。记住，只有在你是防御者时，损失的<color=#748421>士兵</color>才会转化为<color=#748421>仆从</color>，为你复仇。

lct.t3.sacrifice.text: 执行 3 次<color=#748421>献祭</color>行动来获得更多<color=#748421>仆从</color>。

lct.t3.recruit.text: 执行<color=#748421>招募</color>行动来在你的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>附近放置另一个<color=#748421>士兵</color>。

lct.t3.recruit.2.text: 现在让我们再次在你的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>附近的<sprite name="rabbiticon">类型领地<color=#748421>招募</color>来维持秩序。

lct.t3.discard.text: 你的手牌太多了。弃掉 2 张兔子牌可以保证<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>可以保证变成<color=#748421>憎恶遭弃者</color>。

lct.t3.discard.2.text: 你说憎恶这个词不太好听？不不……正义经常像这样被误解。要有耐心，我的朋友，你会明白的。

lct.t4.hated.outcast.text: 正如预言所称的那样，遭弃者牌堆中数量最多的类型正是目前的<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>类型。而这意味着<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>标记将会成为<color=#748421>憎恶遭弃者</color>，你的<color=#748421>阴谋</color>所需要的仆从数量减 1。

lct.t4.convert.text: <color=#748421>蜥蜴神教</color>欢迎新鲜的血液。使用<color=#748421>转化</color>阴谋来将一个位于<color=#748421>遭弃者</color>领地的敌方士兵换成你自己的士兵。

lct.t4.sanctify.text: 你不但要净化灵魂，还要净化那些虚假的建筑。使用<color=#748421>净化</color>来用<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>取代一个敌方建筑。

lct.t4.off.rails.text: 你对于神圣祷文的解读几乎完美。获得<style="vpnumddteen">12</style>点分数，这证明了你对<color=#748421>蜥蜴神教</color>真诚的信仰。

lct.ftt.garden.removed.text: 每当一个<color=#748421>庭院</color>被移除，它会回到你的庭院条上。通常这意味着你从仪式获得的分数会减少。此外你还会随机丢弃一张手牌。因此要保护你的<sprite name="Garden"><color=#748421>庭院</color>，不惜一切代价。
